proposals.before: Empress Dowager Du bore Shizu Emperor Taiwu.
proposals.after: Empress Dowager Du Mi bore Shizu Emperor Taiwu.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English omits 密 from 杜密皇后, which the parallel literal preserves as Du Mi.

proposals.before: Shizu had no son yet and once said: "A brother's son is like one's own son.
proposals.after: Shizu had no son yet and once said: "A brother's son is like one's own son."
proposals.reason: Literal English is missing the closing quotation mark after the emperor's speech.

decisions.after: Empress Mi of the Du clan bore Shizu Emperor Taiwu.
decisions.reason: In 杜密皇后, 杜 is the clan name and 密 is the empress's posthumous style. ‘Empress Mi of the Du clan’ preserves both without misreading Du Mi as a personal name or calling her empress dowager.
s0047 quotes Shizu with closed 「兄弟之子猶子也。」; the literal opens the English quote but drops the closing mark, so restoring " corrects a real punctuation defect without changing sense.
